verdict.rationale: Logseq documents an official `logseq://x-callback-url/quickCapture` protocol action that can be saved as a browser bookmark to send short text and links into the graph. That is a first-party browser capture flow, but it is limited to short snippets and links, not full-page or article clipping. Missing for 10: full web page/article clipping, highlight capture from the browser, a dedicated official browser extension, hands-on corroboration of the capture flow.
